display.purpose: The home banner headline and page heroes.

lead.purpose: Section intros and page summaries, 70 characters a line at most.

body.purpose: Reading text, 70 characters a line at most.

secondary.purpose: Supporting text, notes and card subtitles.

meta.purpose: Timestamps, counts, instructor names and badges; never primary content.

shadows.name: shadow-soft

shadows.name: shadow-raised
shadows.purpose: Menus, dialogs, the sticky course card, the help button and banner arrows.

motion.name: motion-150
motion.purpose: Colour changes, menus, exits, backdrops, FAQ answers.

motion.name: motion-200
motion.purpose: Dialogs, the help panel, the mobile menu, the outline-button fill, card reveals.

motion.name: motion-300
motion.purpose: Block reveals and the banner slide change.

motion.name: ease-enter
motion.purpose: Things arriving: menus, dialogs, the banner, button fills.

motion.name: ease-exit
motion.purpose: Things leaving, such as the outline-button fill draining back.

motion.name: ease-reveal

narrative.overview:
A bright, orderly classroom that anyone recognises at a glance. The room is white and light gray, the writing is charcoal, the furniture is plain and well made, and one warm colour, Marigold Saffron, points to what to do next. Nothing in the room competes with the lesson. The mood is warm, clear and unhurried: friendly without being playful, easy to read, and calm in its pacing and motion.

The system follows the earlier Living With Krishna POC (https://livingwithkrishna.netlify.app) and takes Udemy as its reference for familiarity: full-width photo banners, image-led course cards, rows that swipe on phones and become grids on wider screens. Visitors range from newcomers to long-time devotees, many on low-end phones and slow connections, so the room stays light: one eager image per page, flat surfaces, small tokens, and motion that loads only after the page.

Depth comes from hairline gray borders, not shadows; buttons are bold and plain, as in the POC; the large rounded feature panels on the home page are the one place the room relaxes into generous shapes.
keyCharacteristics: White and light gray canvas, charcoal text, one saffron accent, black primary buttons.
Poppins in three weights (400, 600, 700), large headings tight, reading text open and capped at 70 characters a line.
Rounded corners from three tokens; no square corners anywhere.
Hairline borders first; faint shadows only for things that float.
Quick, quiet motion that never touches what is on screen when the page opens.

rules.name: The One Flame Rule
rules.body: Marigold Saffron marks the next step and stays a small share of any screen; black carries every other button. Large saffron panels are reserved for the early-access offer.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Saffron Rule
rules.body: Text on saffron is black; saffron text on light backgrounds is Saffron Ink. White text never sits on saffron.

rules.name: The POC Palette Rule
rules.body: No colour outside this palette joins the brand. Status colours (green for done, red for errors, yellow for staff notes) appear only in their messages.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400 for reading, 600 for headings and labels, 700 for buttons and prices. Nothing heavier, nothing lighter; no text under 12px.

rules.name: The 70-Character Rule
rules.body: Reading text stops at 70 characters a line, however wide the screen.

rules.name: The One Board Rule
rules.body: Nothing breaks the shared content width except full-bleed bands and the home banner; everything inside a section starts on the board's edge.

rules.name: The 46px Control Rule
rules.body: Buttons and text boxes have 10px of padding above and below, so with the 24px line and 1px borders they stand 46px tall, clear of the 44px touch target. Icon-only buttons are 44px squares.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: A raised surface gets a 1px gray border before any shadow, and no shadow layer passes 7% black.

rules.name: The Colour-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Hover changes a border or text colour; it never grows a shadow or scales a card.

rules.name: The Token Corners Rule
rules.body: Every corner comes from a token. No square corners and no one-off radii.

rules.name: The Quiet Motion Rule
rules.body: Motion only clarifies a change: 8px or less, 300ms or less, and nothing that is on screen when the page opens moves.

dos: Do use black bold buttons for primary actions, and saffron buttons only on photos and dark panels.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px Hairline Gray border and the Soft shadow; give floating layers the Raised shadow.
Do take every corner from the badge (6px), control (8px) or card (12px) token.
Do cap reading text at 70 characters a line and keep text at 12px or larger.
Do mark below-the-fold sections with the scroll reveal attributes, and leave everything above the fold still.
donts: Don't add colours outside the POC palette; the light blue of the old circular logo is not part of the brand.
Don't use weights above 700 or below 400.
Don't add one-sided accent bars to cards; callouts use a full light border in their colour.
Don't grow shadows, scale cards or use bounce, elastic or looping decoration.
Don't auto-rotate the home banner or animate anything at first paint.
Don't use the japa-mala motif anywhere but the contact page.
Don't use glass blur, gradient buttons or decorative blobs.
